name: 片场留白
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a high-fidelity, production-quality DESKTOP WEBSITE UI composition for the public homepage of ViralDNA. Output exactly ONE independent image, 1440 x 960 pixels, landscape. Show the opening viewport plus a small glimpse of the next section, not a tiny full-page screenshot and not a poster. No device or browser frame.

The user has approved the cinematic creative-studio direction. Preserve this direction; vary only composition, proportions and the presentation of the sample-film selector. The purpose is to show impressive film output, clearly explain the creative product, and invite an existing user to enter the app. This is NOT an editor, dashboard, admin page or instant video generator.

Reference image role: the attached repository screenshot supplies ONLY the existing ViralDNA play-mark and wordmark. Use the small violet rounded-square white play triangle at the top left. Do not copy that screenshot's obsolete product labels, stats, sample data, light theme, sidebar, cards or interface layout. No customer material is used.

Visual system: charcoal near-black #0C0C10, white headline #F5F5F7, one muted gray #B2B2BC, existing violet #5B4DF5 only for the main action, keyboard/selection states and the logo. Clean contemporary Chinese sans-serif, precise typography, large two-line hero headline, restrained corner radii and excellent spacing. This is a premium film-making brand surface, not a neon sci-fi console. The imagery itself carries warm amber light and rich shadows. All core UI is readable and arranged like a realistic buildable website. There are no invented customers, testimonials, traffic numbers, prices, free-signup claims, benchmark claims, integrations, badges or claims of instant generation. No decorative DNA helix, floating orbs, holograms or fake code.

Use a single highly polished SYNTHETIC DEMO film still as the main media: an unbranded smoky amber glass product bottle with a brushed silver cap, sculptural but physically plausible, on dark basalt with an elegant warm rim light and a restrained reflection. The product is cleanly visible on the right half; the left half has true dark negative space for legible UI. It must look like a frame of premium product cinematography, with actual material detail, not a generic abstract wallpaper. This bottle and the sample film stills are design illustrations, not real product results. Include the legible modest label "视觉示意 · 非真实案例" beside the sample-film selector. No label or brand lettering on the bottle.

Exact navigation text: "ViralDNA"; "作品案例"; "创作流程"; "Skill"; "团队协作"; right action "进入创作台".
Exact hero headline on TWO lines: "看懂好视频，" then "把创意做成片。"
Exact body copy, split naturally into two short lines if needed: "从原视频分析或 Skill 出发，连接分镜、图像、视频与剪辑，让每一步创作都清晰可控。"
Hero primary button: "进入创作台" with a small arrow. Secondary: "观看演示" with a small play icon.
Exactly THREE sample selector thumbnails with short labels: "产品特写", "场景演绎", "运镜节奏". Use the same unbranded demo product in three cinematic shot contexts. First is selected by a fine violet outline, not by a success/approval badge. A small accessible pause button sits near the playing-media corner.
At the very bottom glimpse of next section, use exact headings "有参考，就从分析开始。" and "有想法，就从 Skill 开始。" if space permits. Do not cram full feature panels into this viewport.

Layout discipline: one dominant visual moment, a clear heading and a single primary action. Use alignment and negative space before boxes. No cards inside cards. Keep navigation around 15-16px, body around 18px, headline around 72px, CTA controls about 48px high at this canvas size. Hero text never overlaps the product silhouette. Maintain generous margins and readable contrast. Small annotation and sample labels remain readable. Output one polished website screen, all Chinese text accurate, no spelling errors, no planned option numbers, no moodboard collage or design annotations outside the site.

Composition name: 片场留白.
Layout: 72px dark top navigation with 64px horizontal padding. In the main hero, keep the left roughly 43% as a quiet charcoal editorial column; the right 57% is a tall cinematic product scene extending down close to the next section, separated only by the natural light-to-shadow edge, no border or panel. Copy is positioned at x=72, y=265; headline is large and left-aligned on two lines, body below with a comfortable narrow measure, then aligned primary and secondary buttons. Product still starts around x=590 and occupies almost the full remaining height, with larger breathing room around the bottle and beautiful physically grounded light. Put the three small film thumbnail selectors at the lower edge INSIDE the media on the right, aligned horizontally, with the "视觉示意 · 非真实案例" label just above; pause control beside them. The next-section opening at y=870 reads as a quiet continuation. This composition emphasizes the assured separation of reading and cinematic imagery, while still feeling like one seamless premium film-stage page. No bordered right-hand app card, no floating panels.
approval_source: 用户在 2026-09-13 附上对应视觉稿截图并确认：选择这一种风格。
